# Function that returns an r object with data

Function that returns an r object with data

## Usage

``` r
pickmdl_data(dataset)
```

## Arguments

- dataset:

  Name of data set within the pickmdl package

## Value

An r object with data

## Details

**myseries:** A univariate time series made from
`pickmdl_data("datainn")`

**allvar:** Matrix of time series (mts) made from
`pickmdl_data("kalendernr3")`

**datainn:** A vector of data.

**kalendernr3:** As `read.table("kalendernr3.txt")`

**myseries_old:** Old version of `myseries`, directly from `datainn`.
